reviews.summary: Someone who searched "things I love about you" got the format defined but no list of things to take; point them to the twenty single-detail lines already on the page.

Every template claim checks out against manifest, schema and Template.tsx; four Spanish lines needed work: 'sirven para él o para ella' contradicted the intro's note on endings, and 'pocas como para', 've unos días por delante' and 'llegar ... de alguien' read as translated.

Beats the generic lists with moment-based reasons, a method, the 52-card how-to and the 'Why do you love me?' answers, but the People-also-ask question "What are 20 reasons why I love you?" went unanswered.

applied: Pointer from the 'things I love about you' section to 'Things only I get to see' and 'The way you look and feel' (twenty single details), both languages

Spanish: 'cambiando alguna terminación si hace falta'; 'Diez, las justas para…'; 'escríbelas mes a mes, lleva siempre unos días de ventaja'; 'Suele salir en un mal día, medio en broma, y quien lo pregunta quiere oírlo de verdad'
'Twenty' added to the how-many list (the first two from each of the ten categories), both languages

Polish: 'a husband or a wife'; 'the days I get to spend with you' (quote and FAQ); 'reasons are the ones that get reread'; Spanish 'más rápido' and 'Pero sobre todo, los días que paso contigo soy más feliz'
rejected: Polish not taken: a printing tip for the jar, a short-lines note in the 52-card step (the reader's fix covers it), 'properly' rewording, the Spanish description ending, a girlfriend link beside the boyfriend one

reviews.summary: It gives the hundred and then makes them yours: a method, a before-and-after table, ten tonight or twenty from the categories, 52 themed cards, and three plain answers for when they ask why.

All round-one fixes made correctly; every product claim matches the code, and the Spanish (baraja de póker, figuras, comodines) reads like Spain, which the scraped lists that rank don't come close to.
Every on-intent People-also-ask question is answered (20, 52, husband, 'why do you love me'), which none of the generic 125-to-180-item lists ranking now combine with a method and a how-many guide.

rejected: Final-round polish kept out of the post as the rubric says: a time estimate for ten, a girlfriend link, the long-distance anniversary link, 'para tu marido o tu mujer' in Spanish
